implementation: Independent native reader; no upstream installer code or binaries are executed or linked.
container: One or more DEADBEEF groups, 288-byte __NAILZHUFLIB member headers, original-size prefix then standard adaptive LH1, 17-byte NAISIGN group trailers, 178-byte manifest records, _SUPERDAT_HEADER footer before an optional PE certificate.
limitations: Verified classic engine and modern resource-plus-payload LH1 generations only. Member filenames must be safe ASCII paths. Group NAISIGN checksum semantics have not been identified; per-member manifest CRCs are validated where present. Unsupported layouts and codecs fail explicitly. TEST decodes to a CRC sink without payload staging; extraction validates before creating a destination and streams a second pass.
